origin: Original pure source assembly. Pinned m1n1 sources were read as behaviour maps; no upstream, Linux or macOS driver code is copied.

HV_selection_and_ADT_edits.facts: init stores iodev_whoami() as self.iodev and then calls setup_adt once; setup_adt appends ' on m1n1 hypervisor' to product-name/description, sets product-soc-name to 'Virtual <soc> on [cursed ]m1n1 hypervisor', and deletes the listed /arm-io subtrees for iodev >= USB0 with idx = iodev - USB0; load_raw (later) removes the first __OS_LOG name and its 32-byte row from /arm-io children and their children.

IODEV_enum.facts: IODEV(IntEnum) members UART=0 through USB7=11, with USB0=4; iodev_whoami returns IODEV(...).

ADT_rebuild.facts: Rebuilt property = PaddedString(32) key, u32 size, value, Aligned(4) zero padding; a NUL-terminated printable value is typed CString and rebuilt with one NUL.

facts: Original and prepared raw ADTs are separate mandatory inputs, both extracted by the frozen inventory; the original carries no HV product marker and the prepared carries exactly one pinned setup_adt product rewrite.
Prepared inventoried properties equal the original after exactly the USB0 subtree deletion and first-__OS_LOG removal; unchanged ones byte-exact, rewritten ones equal to the pinned m1n1 rebuild.
Occurrence map is node + projected slot + whole row + label, complete, strictly increasing and injective; one segment map serves physical and remap observations.
Every original pmap/physical/remap row is emitted in original order and multiplicity; identity slot 3 stays the prepared base ADT.
Records 256, relevant physical union 8 and join receipt 65536 bytes refuse when exceeded; nothing is truncated.
source_iodev must be the exact built-in int 4; the host helper derives it only from the USB0 member of a standard-metaclass IODEV IntEnum defined in the supplied module, via int.__int__.
unproven: Fresh same-boot acquisition, source authenticity, quiescence or a full-ADT replay beyond inventoried properties
Global device exclusion coverage or VM allocator boundaries beyond the BootArgs envelope
That a runtime proxy_module is the pinned proxy.py; that is the host caller's binding
Any applied native wire, actual final ADT upload/readback or kernel configuration
Native physical ownership, DART, PCIe, MSI, firmware or Wi-Fi operation
